finding: RELATED — Velocore V1 (L2 watchlist row; H-47 covered Velocore V2)
title: Velocore V1 (zkSync Era): permissionless gauge emission capture (~$2k E-U) and 67.8M VC permanently stranded in the Voter

category_notes.E-U: Create pair + gauge (permissionless for whitelisted tokens) -> buy/lock VC -> vote -> Voter.distribute pays the gauge the attacker's share of the 414,941 VC/week mint -> Gauge.getReward -> sell VC. Realizable amount bounded by VC exit liquidity (~$7.8k hard-asset side across VC/WETH + VC/USDC pools). Fork-proven end-to-end (215,687.57 VC to the gauge; 92,438.60 VC claimed by the attacker).
category_notes.H-O: LP positions in the 171 V1 pools (~$125.3k), locked veVC in VotingEscrow (39,677,494 VC ~ $43.9k), legacy gauge rewards for historical stakers (831,441 VC ~ $920), RewardsDistributor claims by veNFT owners (651,725 VC ~ $721).
category_notes.P: Governor/emergencyCouncil EOA 0x1234561fEd41DD2D867a038bBdB857f291864225: killGauge/reviveGauge/setGovernor/setEmergencyCouncil/whitelist + swap-fee stream (0.5% of F2 swaps, 0.25% of F1 swaps) paid directly to that EOA.
category_notes.S: Voter balance 67,837,832.79 VC (~$75.0k notional) permanently stranded: all 46 gauges are isAlive=false and _updateFor skips dead gauges (supplyIndex := index, no accrual); new gauges start at the current index (no retroactive capture); no rescue/sweep; Voter is not a proxy.

closed_reasons: June-2024 Velocore V2 defect (missing vault check on velocore__execute + uncapped feeMultiplier/fee1e9 + unchecked fee underflow) is absent from V1 pools: velocore__execute/fee1e9/feeMultiplier/lastWithdrawTimestamp all revert on live V1 pools.
V2-on-zkSync vault holds only 0.000407 ETH and no tokens (nothing to extract even if the fee bug persisted there).
Voter's 67.8M VC is unreachable: all gauges dead; _updateFor destroys accrual; no rescue function; not a proxy (fork-verified with a 52%-weight attacker vote: gauge payout 0).
Legacy gauge rewards (831k VC) only claimable by accounts staked during the 2023 reward periods; earned() = 0 for new stakers.
RewardsDistributor claim(tokenId) pays only the veNFT owner; a freshly created veNFT claimed 0 (no retroactive accrual).
skim() excess across all 171 pools = 0 for priced tokens (pool balances == reserves); only 4.18e-9 LIBERA dust.
Pool swap fees (0.5%/0.25% of input) are routed directly to the owner EOA on every swap (privileged revenue, not extractable).

poc.method: anvil-zksync v0.7.1 fork of zkSync Era mainnet (keyless public RPC); ci/run.sh + ci/fork_test.py

key_facts: V1 = 171 Solidly/Velodrome-V1-family pools on zkSync Era: official factory 0xE140EaC2bB748c8F456719a457F26636617Bb0E9 (167 pairs) + old POAP factory 0xF5719b1Ea3C9bF6491E22C49379E31060d0FbFc1 (4 pairs); TVL ~$125.3k at block 72,471,542 (DefiLlama $126.3k / watchlist $131.9k).
Largest pools: F2 USDC.e/WETH 26,772.40 USDC + 10.6819 WETH (~$53.5k) and F1 USDC.e/old-WETH 20,462.95 USDC + 8.1515 oldWETH (~$40.9k; old-WETH is fully ETH-backed: supply == contract ETH balance).

Minter 0x8f0b4B3e211c84061ab5959Bd3D49C6B3EeC1d7D still mints 419,132.5 VC/week; update_period() is permissionless and was last advanced 2025-09-04; ~414,941 VC/week reaches the Voter, ~17,290 VC goes to the governor EOA.

Voter 0xe09A60FAe6d77658b9767A70e2f361b46Dd3f16A: 67,837,832.79 VC balance, 46 gauges (all isAlive=false), totalWeight 4,565,832.7 veVC, governor/emergencyCouncil = EOA 0x1234561fEd41DD2D867a038bBdB857f291864225; no EIP-1967 slots; no rescue functions.
createPair / createGauge / distribute / Gauge.getReward are all permissionless; whitelist at block 72,471,542 = {VC, WETH, USDC.e, USD+, ZKDOGE}.
VotingEscrow 0xbdE345771Eb0c6adEBc54F41A169ff6311fE096F holds 39,677,494.5 VC locked; MAXTIME 4 years; create_lock(amount, duration) permissionless.
VC price $0.001106; DEX exit liquidity: VC/WETH 2.4003 WETH + 5.45M VC ($12.06k), VC/USDC ~$796, SpaceFi $18; hard-asset side sellable ~$7.8k.
caveats: V1 pool/gauge/Voter sources are unverified; behaviour established by selector probing, raw storage reads and fork execution rather than source review.

The exact internal reason _updateFor skips accrual on dead gauges (isAlive short-circuit vs. mis-keyed weights) is not distinguishable without source, but the no-payout outcome is directly proven for both a dead gauge and a fresh alive gauge.
E-U USD is bounded by DEX exit liquidity (~$7.8k hard-asset side) and depends on the attacker's capital/VC purchase size; the headline $2k is a realistic mid-point, confidence medium.
Fork cheats (storage write for attacker VC, account impersonation for token funding) model attacker capital only; all protocol interactions are real mainnet bytecode.
Stable-pool rounding math (54 stable pools, ~$5k TVL) was not fuzzed; volatile pools (~$110k) were spot-checked.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$2k live (range $1k-$8k) from Velocore V1 on zkSync by creating a pool+gauge, buying and locking VC, voting, calling distribute() to route the 414,941 VC/week emission to their gauge and selling it into the ~$7.8k exit liquidity; the 67.8M VC sitting in the Voter is permanently stuck (S) and the June-2024 V2 fee-accounting defect does not exist in V1.
